summary: Full backend + frontend testing of recipe-card PDF generation feature. All 13 provided pytest cases pass. Added 8 supplementary tests (test_recipe_card_iter15.py) covering the exact review-request scenarios (kabobs copy generated, kabobs orig generated, auth matrix on both endpoints, admin generate returns exact key set, uploaded-valid-PDF preference with marker + ?source=generated override, and cleanup). All 8 pass. Frontend Playwright tests confirm: user recipe-card-download works and returns valid 1-page PDF 'Rainbow_Fruit_Kabobs_Copy_Recipe_Card.pdf' starting with %PDF; admin RecipesAdmin list shows correct 'Uploaded card' (Kabobs Copy) vs 'Generated card' (original Kabobs) labels; admin gencard button confirm dialog contains recipe title and 'does not change the recipe'; cancel path issues NO /card/generate request; accept path downloads 'Rainbow_Fruit_Kabobs_Recipe_Card.pdf' and shows success toast 'Recipe card ready — 1 page, with photo. Members receive this generated card.'; recipe H1 renders normally; Admin Flags tab and weekly-drop 'Send preview to me' button both present (not clicked).
critical_code_review_comments: Login response returns key 'token' not 'access_token' — worth documenting for future test agents (already handled in iter15 tests).
POST /api/files/upload returns key 'file_id' (not 'id') — inconsistent with recipe create which returns 'id'. Consider unifying response key naming.
Recipe create requires 'tier' (little/junior/teen/adult) — clarify in API docs; iter15 test discovered via 422.
